chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The engraving of the ring of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was 'Muhammad, Messenger of Allah', and the engraving of the ring of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was 'Allah, the King', and the engraving of the ring of my father (peace be upon him) was 'The Honour is for Allah'.
ai.seo_question: What were the inscriptions on the rings of the Prophet and the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the distinct inscriptions on the signet rings of the Prophet, Imam Ali, and Imam al-Baqir, serving as a key text in Shia jurisprudence regarding the permissibility and etiquette of using rings. The progression from 'Muhammadun Rasul Allah' to 'Al-Malik' and finally 'Al-Izzu Lillah' reflects the evolving theological emphasis on divine sovereignty and honor, linking the Imams' authority directly to God's attributes.
